brief.scope: Author focused acceptance tests from ops/conductor/lane-mcp-v2.md and the v1 lever contract. Write ops/conductor/tests/test_lane_mcp_context.py, reusing existing test fixtures when useful. Do not read lane_read.py or lane_mcp.py; no new implementation exists. Cover all three v2 reads, config/version isolation, _meta transport parity, source boundaries, cursor/progress behavior, explicit missing/unavailable/omitted data, and registry cards. Use small synthetic fixtures and meaningful positive/negative pairs; avoid a large generated corpus or a test for each literal. Check CLI, real stdio tools and resources. Preserve old tests. Run each new behavior and record the actual red cause; distinguish new-feature absence from assertions already green on the baseline. Commit the test file as soon as the red evidence exists, with specific model trailers. No production edits. If a contract ambiguity prevents a decisive assertion, report it rather than invent behavior.

findings.claim: A first-page frame that exceeds 8192 bytes, or that leaves too little room for a fully reduced entry so the note must be dropped, cannot be planted from the declared field caps and Linux PATH_MAX without measuring the encoder. Tests force pagination with eight ~900-byte claims and pin omitted-for-type/cap; they do not assert the exact omission sequence at the 8192-byte edge.
